heroGrammar: Editorial coastal arrival hero with serif tide headline, warm reservation action, calm right-side retreat image placeholder, compact guest metrics, and embedded booking tray.
gridSystem: Light editorial 1440 source frame with soft gutters, booking-bar columns, calm three-card stay grids, asymmetrical amenity clusters, and tide-colored bands.
layoutGesture: Boutique booking journey: arrive emotionally, check availability, understand the place, choose a stay, trust the amenities, then reserve calmly.
sectionSilhouettes: serif split hero with booking tray
three stay cards on pearl field
amenity side stacks around center media
large white invitation panel over tide footer
compositionTension: Quiet hospitality pacing uses editorial pauses, shell-like cards, coral actions, and a dark tide contrast section instead of SaaS density.
focalPath: Serif arrival headline to booking tray to destination story to stays/amenities to policy confidence and reservation closure.
negativeSpaceShape: Pearl margins, generous vertical pauses, and framed image-placeholder wells make the destination feel slow and premium.
depthLayering: Soft tide shadows, raised booking tray, stay card relief, inset image wells, and warm CTA lift create luxury without heavy effects.
moduleScaleVariation: Large editorial hero, compact booking bar, wide story split, card collection, asymmetric amenity map, timeline cards, gallery row, and invitation panel.
breakoutBehavior: Booking tray bridges hero and page, dark itinerary band interrupts the light editorial field, and final CTA sits as a large hospitality invitation panel.
layoutRhythm: Emotional arrival, utility booking, story proof, stay choice, amenity reassurance, itinerary clarity, visual proof, policy confidence, final invitation.
cardCadence: Booking fields, stay cards, amenity tiles, itinerary cards, gallery placeholders, guest review cards, FAQ rows, and footer map cells each use different scale and purpose.
componentPatterns: navigation, header, reservation button, booking tray, input field, stay card, amenity tile, itinerary card, gallery placeholder, location map cue, review card, FAQ row, CTA panel, footer
ctaPlacement: Reservation action appears in the hero, booking tray, seasonal package, and final invitation panel, with softer suite exploration nearby.
imageTreatment: Retreat imagery remains editable through explicit text placeholders for hero photo, destination story, suites, gallery, map, and guest portraits.
spacingCadence: Generous editorial spacing, compact booking utility spacing, calm card gaps, and strong contrast between pearl fields and tide bands.
typographyBehavior: Instrument Serif handles destination emotion and slow luxury; Manrope carries booking fields, labels, policy rows, and marketplace source notes.
colorRoles: Pearl background, pale mist surfaces, deep tide panels, coral action, brass micro proof, sea-glass placeholders, ink text, and muted coastal gray.
effectLanguage: Soft tide shadow, coral booking shadow, light card relief, and subtle inset image wells tied to hospitality trust and invitation moments.
navigationPattern: Boutique stay nav with stays, experiences, amenities, journal, contact, and a distinct availability action.
footerPattern: Hospitality footer map with rooms, stay detail, gallery, booking, experiences, journal, contact, policy, and compact final nav.
visualGrammarSummary: Luxury coastal booking template with editorial calm, booking completeness, textured stay/amenity modules, and source-friendly hospitality placeholders.
marketplaceReadinessSummary: Twelve meaningful homepage blocks including booking tray, stays, amenities, itinerary, gallery, reviews, FAQ, CTA, footer map, and separate design-system board.
